meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库，识别架构改进点，用可视化报告呈现并逐项深入分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接手或维护一个老代码库，想系统梳理架构改进点
copy.tagline_en: Scan codebase, surface architecture wins, and deep-dive via visual report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear architecture assessment of your codebase to decide where to improve.

howto.what: 当用户要求时，Claude 会扫描代码库，找出架构上的问题（如浅模块），生成一份可视化 HTML 报告，列出多个改进方案，每个包含前后对比和推荐强度，最后给出首选建议，并询问你想深入讨论哪个。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求扫描代码库、寻找架构改进机会，或指定某个模块/痛点进行分析时触发；命令不会自动启动，需用户主动提出。

say.text: 扫描这个项目，把架构上的问题整理成报告。
say.note: 会生成 HTML 报告并自动打开。

say.text: 重点看看最近改动多的模块，有哪些值得深化？
帮我列出架构改进候选项，并给出推荐优先级。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude scans the codebase, finds architecture issues (like shallow modules), and produces an HTML report with candidate improvements, each with before/after visuals and a recommendation badge. It ends with a top pick and asks which one to explore.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks for an architecture review, to find deepening opportunities, or when pointing at a specific module/pain point. The command is not auto-invoked; it requires a user request.

say_en.text: Scan this project and turn architectural issues into a report.
say_en.note: Generates an HTML report and opens it.

say_en.text: Look at recently changed modules—are any worth deepening?
List the architecture candidates with priorities.
say_en.note: Report ends with a top recommendation.
